links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT responses on orbital and oculofacial disease
links.effect: Responses showed high reading-level complexity, representing college or graduate education comprehension levels.
links.quote: The responses exhibited a high reading-level complexity, representing the comprehension levels of a college or graduate education.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT-4.0 across 100 questions regarding orbital and oculofacial disorders evaluated by clinical experts, but does not test any deployment practice or guardrail.
